title: Tree with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Ground -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='93' rx='38' ry='6' fill='#3a7d44'/>
  <!-- Trunk -->
  <rect x='42' y='58' width='16' height='32' rx='4' fill='#a05a2c'/>
  <rect x='42' y='58' width='6' height='32' rx='3' fill='#c47a3e'/>
  <!-- Roots -->
  <path d='M42 88 Q34 92 28 90' stroke='#a05a2c' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 88 Q66 92 72 90' stroke='#a05a2c' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Canopy -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='26' fill='#4caf50'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='48' r='16' fill='#43a047'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='48' r='16' fill='#43a047'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='24' r='15' fill='#66bb6a'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='24' r='15' fill='#66bb6a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='20' r='13' fill='#81c784'/>

  <circle cx='41' cy='40' r='3.5' fill='#1b5e20'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='40' r='3.5' fill='#1b5e20'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='39' r='1.2' fill='#a5d6a7'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='39' r='1.2' fill='#a5d6a7'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M40 50 Q50 60 60 50' stroke='#1b5e20' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='48' r='3' fill='#f48fb1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='48' r='3' fill='#f48fb1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Little leaves -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='30' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#81c784' transform='rotate(-30 28 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='30' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#81c784' transform='rotate(30 72 30)'/>
</svg>
